ResourceHeader.ResourceName: GOES-16 EXIS/XRS Science Level 1b X-ray Irradiance
ResourceHeader.AlternateName: EXIS XRS L1b Science-Quality Solar Flux: X-Ray
ResourceHeader.Description: GOES-16 Extreme Ultraviolet and X-ray Irradiance Sensors (EXIS) X-Ray Sensor (XRS) science-quality Level 1b data in daily aggregated NetCDF-4 files. The product contains calibrated 1-second solar X-ray irradiance measurements from four detectors: XRS-A1 and XRS-A2 in the 0.05-0.4 nm band, and XRS-B1 and XRS-B2 in the 0.1-0.8 nm band. The high-sensitivity A1/B1 detectors use single photodiodes; the lower-sensitivity A2/B2 detectors use quadrant photodiodes. Separate corrected quadrant currents, data-quality and invalid-condition flags, observation times, and instrument and spacecraft ancillary measurements are included. NOAA NCEI generates the science-quality L1b product from GOES-R EXIS Level 0 source data using retrospectively improved processing and updated calibrations, and aggregates the original 30-second segments into daily files. This science-quality processing stream is separate from the operational Level 1b product used for real-time space-weather operations. The NetCDF archive can contain missing or flagged samples. NOAA generally recommends the science-quality Level 2 XRS products for scientific analysis.

Parameter.Name: Time
Parameter.Description: Center time of each XRS observation, expressed as seconds since 2000-01-01 12:00:00 UTC, neglecting leap seconds.

Parameter.Name: XRS-A1 Irradiance
Parameter.Description: Solar X-ray irradiance measured by the XRS-A1 high-sensitivity single photodiode (solar minimum channel) in the 0.05-0.4 nm band. The NetCDF variable is calculated assuming a flat spectrum; the recorded irradiance is a band-integrated energy flux at the spacecraft.

Parameter.Name: XRS-A2 Irradiance
Parameter.Description: Solar X-ray irradiance measured by the XRS-A2 lower-sensitivity quadrant photodiode (solar maximum channel) in the 0.05-0.4 nm band. The NetCDF variable is calculated assuming a flat spectrum; the recorded irradiance is a band-integrated energy flux at the spacecraft.

Parameter.Name: XRS-B1 Irradiance
Parameter.Description: Solar X-ray irradiance measured by the XRS-B1 high-sensitivity single photodiode (solar minimum channel) in the 0.1-0.8 nm band. The NetCDF variable is calculated assuming a flat spectrum; the recorded irradiance is a band-integrated energy flux at the spacecraft.

Parameter.Name: XRS-B2 Irradiance
Parameter.Description: Solar X-ray irradiance measured by the XRS-B2 lower-sensitivity quadrant photodiode (solar maximum channel) in the 0.1-0.8 nm band. The NetCDF variable is calculated assuming a flat spectrum; the recorded irradiance is a band-integrated energy flux at the spacecraft.

Parameter.Name: XRS-A2 Quadrant 1 Corrected Photodiode Current
Parameter.Description: Corrected electric current from quadrant 1 of the XRS-A2 (solar maximum) quadrant photodiode. Four separately recorded quadrant currents provide information relevant to X-ray flare localization and photodiode response.

Parameter.Name: XRS L1b Data Quality Flags
Parameter.Description: Bit-field describing Level 1b processing status and data-quality conditions including pointing, calibration, detector and telemetry anomalies. Interpret individual bits using the NetCDF flag_values, flag_masks and flag_meanings attributes.

Parameter.Name: XRS L1b Invalid Condition Flags
Parameter.Description: Flag field describing potentially invalid measurements, such as detector integration-time changes, stimulus-lamp state changes and EDAC events. Interpret codes using the NetCDF flag_values and flag_meanings attributes.
